title: The Bronze Pillar
lines: Da Ji's most infamous creation was the Bronze Pillar — an immense hollow column heated with charcoal until it glowed red. She had suspected ministers and innocent courtiers forced to embrace it.
When Queen Jiang protested Da Ji's cruelty, Da Ji had her eyes gouged out and her hands severed. The king watched, indifferent, his mind poisoned by the fox's enchantment.
One by one, the loyal ministers fled or were executed. The people despaired. The Mandate of Heaven was about to shift — and the gods prepared for war.
